meta.title: The Hobbled Horse
meta.logline: An eighth-grader walking home across a wide field rides a hobbled horse with only its hobble rope for a bridle, gets carried into a stranger's teff, and saves himself with one well-aimed jump into the mud.
meta.audience: The friends who were there, my family, and Ethiopians who grew up walking to school across fields and now watch on their phones in cities or abroad.
meta.intent: Viewers laugh at the mischief, feel the green, muddy tsedey season again, and think 'that was us'; the friends recognise the day.

style.block: Photorealistic cinematic film still, shot on a 35mm lens with shallow depth of field, natural golden late-afternoon light, rural Amhara highlands of Ethiopia in the green tsedey season after the rains, wet earth, scattered yellow adey abeba flowers, rich true-to-life colour, gentle film grain, documentary realism.
style.negative: cartoon, illustration, painting, anime, 3d render, text, letters, watermark, logo, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed horse, extra legs, distorted face, modern buildings, cars, plastic backpack

characters.name: the boy (me, age 14)
characters.description: a slim 14-year-old Ethiopian boy with short curly black hair, brown skin, a round face and a mischievous grin, wearing a faded light-blue school uniform shirt, dark-blue shorts and black plastic sandals

characters.name: his two friends
characters.description: two Ethiopian schoolboys aged 13 to 14 in the same faded light-blue school uniform shirts and dark-blue shorts; one tall and thin with a shaved head, one shorter and stocky wearing a red knitted cap

characters.name: the horse
characters.description: a small sturdy Ethiopian highland horse with a chestnut-brown coat, short black mane, a white blaze on its forehead, no saddle, a frayed grey rope

voice.style_instruction: Read in Amharic as a grown man fondly remembering his childhood to old friends: warm, a little amused, unhurried, with small pauses between sentences. Let excitement rise during the gallop and relief and laughter come through at the end.

music.caption: playful Ethiopian highland folk, masinqo and krar, light kebero hand drum, acoustic, warm, mischievous and nostalgic, sparse at first, lively galloping rhythm in the middle, settling into a gentle warm ending

cues.note: kebero enters as the horse is found and caught
full gallop rhythm: ride, teff field, the owner
break on the jump, then a laughing, light return
warm resolve and fade under the end card

shots.reason: Establish the wide field and the long walk that frames the whole memory.

keyframe.prompt: A vast green highland meadow with a thin dirt footpath winding across it toward a small school with a tin roof on a distant hill, morning light, low clouds

narration.text: ስምንተኛ ክፍል እያለሁ፣ ወደ ትምህርት ቤት ረጅም መንገድ በእግሬ እሄድ ነበር።
narration.english: In eighth grade, I walked a long way to school.

shots.reason: Introduce the three boys together, the bond the film is really about.

keyframe.prompt: The boy and his two friends walk home side by side along the footpath through the wide meadow in late-afternoon light, handwoven cloth akofada bags over their shoulders, seen from the front

motion.prompt: the three boys walk slowly toward the camera, grass sways in the wind, camera static

narration.text: መንገዳችን ሰፊ ሜዳ ያቋርጣል። አንድ ቀን፣ ከጓደኞቼ ጋር ስንመለስ…
narration.english: Our road crossed a wide field. One day, walking home with my friends…

shots.reason: Reveal the temptation: a horse that cannot run away, its front legs hobbled.

keyframe.prompt: The horse grazing alone in the meadow, its two front legs tied together with the frayed grey hobble rope, yellow flowers around its hooves

motion.prompt: the horse lowers its head and grazes, tail swishes, camera static

narration.english: we found a hobbled horse in the field.

shots.reason: The decision moment, and the akofada handed over: the detail the friends will remember.

keyframe.prompt: The grinning boy hands a small handwoven white-and-grey cotton cloth akofada shoulder bag with a long strap to his tall friend, the stocky friend laughs beside them, the horse blurred in the background

narration.english: “Let's ride it!” we said. My friends held my satchel for me.

shots.reason: Show the mistake that drives the story: the hobble rope tied on as a bridle.

keyframe.prompt: The two friends hold the horse steady while the boy ties the grey hobble rope around the horse's muzzle as a makeshift bridle, close together in the meadow

motion.prompt: the boy pulls the rope tight around the muzzle, the horse shakes its head, camera static

narration.text: ፈረሱን ከበን ያዝነው። በመቀየጃ ገመዱ አፉን ሸብቤ ወጣሁት።
narration.english: We surrounded it and caught it. I tied its mouth with the hobble rope and climbed on.

shots.reason: The release: one word and the horse explodes into a gallop.

keyframe.prompt: The boy riding bareback on the horse as it bursts into a gallop across the meadow, mud and grass flying from the hooves, his friends small in the background

motion.prompt: the horse gallops left to right, the boy clings on, camera pans to follow

narration.english: When I said “Go!”, it took off at a gallop.

shots.reason: Close on the struggle so the audience feels the loss of control.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of the boy leaning back, pulling hard on the rope with both hands, eyes wide, the horse's head and black mane straining forward

motion.prompt: the boy pulls the rope back, the horse pushes forward, bouncing motion, camera static

narration.text: ላስቆመው ሞከርኩ፤ እምቢ አለኝ። ገመዱ እንደ ልጓም አልገታው አለ።
narration.english: I tried to stop it; it refused. The rope was no bridle.

shots.reason: Raise the stakes: someone else's crop, and friends panicking.

keyframe.prompt: The horse charges with the boy into a tall golden-green teff field, stalks bending, while the two friends stand at the field's edge waving their arms and shouting

narration.text: የሰው ጤፍ ውስጥ ይዞኝ ገባ። ጓደኞቼ “ጣለው!” እያሉ ተጨነቁ።
narration.english: It carried me into someone's teff. My friends panicked, shouting “Let go!”

shots.reason: The ticking clock: the owner coming, kept far and faceless.

keyframe.prompt: Far across the meadow, a tiny distant figure of a man in a white gabi shawl with a walking stick striding toward the viewer, face not visible, wide empty green field in between

narration.english: Then I saw the owner coming from far away.

shots.reason: The climax and the boy's own choice: jump, and choose where to land.

keyframe.prompt: The boy leaping sideways off the galloping horse in mid-air above a patch of dark wet mud, arms out, the horse running on

motion.prompt: the boy falls slowly toward the mud, the horse runs out of frame, camera static

narration.text: ፈረሱ እየሮጠ ሳለ ዘልዬ ወረድኩ። ሆን ብዬ ጭቃው ላይ ወደቅኩ።
narration.english: As it raced on, I jumped off and landed in the mud on purpose.

shots.reason: Release the tension into laughter; the season saved him.

keyframe.prompt: The boy sitting in the mud, covered in it and laughing, his two friends running up to him laughing, one holding a small handwoven white-and-grey cotton cloth akofada shoulder bag with a long strap

motion.prompt: the friends run in and help the boy up, all laughing, camera static

narration.text: ወቅቱ ጸደይ ነበርና ምንም አልተጎዳሁም። ጓደኞቼም ደስ አላቸው።
narration.english: It was tsedey, the ground was soft, and I wasn't hurt. My friends were so relieved.

shots.reason: The shared escape: three boys running, the image the friends will keep.

keyframe.prompt: The three boys running away together across the meadow toward the setting sun, laughing, cloth akofada bags bouncing, yellow flowers all around, seen from behind

motion.prompt: the boys run away from the camera into the distance, grass sways, camera static

narration.text: አብረን እየሮጥን አመለጥን። ባለ ፈረሱም ሳይመታን ቀረ።
narration.english: We ran off together, and the owner never got to beat us.

shots.reason: Bring it to the present with a real photo of the three friends today: the true story behind the generated film.

keyframe.prompt: The empty meadow at dusk, a chestnut horse grazing peacefully far away, warm last light and first stars

narration.text: ዛሬም ስንገናኝ፣ ያንን ፈረስ እያስታወስን እንስቃለን።
narration.english: Even today, when we meet, we remember that horse and laugh.

end_card.text: Made with AI: images, motion, voice and music were generated by AI from a true story. The final photo is real.
